# LALUM

> LALUM is a Tech-Legal practice uniting law, real estate, and artificial intelligence, led by Dr. Avraham Lalum (Attorney and Notary, Ph.D. in Law and Economics). Based in Herzliya, Israel, LALUM guides property deals and buyers in Israel and abroad, represents owners and rights-holders, runs decision-oriented mediation (DOM), and governs AI risk with EU AI Act conformity.

LALUM brings law, real estate, and AI together in one practice. On the real estate side it guides buyers and investors through transactions in Israel and abroad, represents owners and rights-holders, and handles urban renewal. On the AI side it turns legal risk into a system that can be controlled: certified, ex-ante legal opinions, documented conformity, and defensible records. This site provides general information and is not legal advice; an attorney and client relationship begins only with a signed engagement.

## What LALUM does

- Representing overseas property buyers: guiding buyers and investors through property deals in Israel and abroad, from due diligence to closing.
- Representation of property owners and rights-holders: protecting owners, sellers, and holders of rights in real estate matters and disputes.
- Real estate transactions and urban renewal: purchase, sale, and urban renewal deals, with the tax and contract layer handled end to end.
- Mediation and Dispute Resolution (DOM): Decision-Oriented Mediation for real estate, corporate, AI, and regulatory disputes.
- AI Regulation and EU AI Act conformity: risk classification, GPAI obligations, technical documentation, and a conformity matrix for technology exporters and for M&A and VC due diligence.
- AI Liability and Risk Governance: a conformity index and executive exposure matrix for boards, executives, and CPAs.
- IP and Data Protection: a defensible IP layer and a secure, Privacy-by-Design data architecture.
- Contracts and Venture Counsel: contract governance, counsel for startups and technology companies, funding rounds, founder agreements, and technology due diligence.
- Public Sector AI: explainable, bias-audited decision systems for authorities, ministries, and public tenders.

## Languages

The site is available in Hebrew (primary) and English. Every page renders in both; the English rendering of any page is reachable by adding ?lang=en to its address.
